name: Fammily Symbls
shortDescription: A small stained-glass family window using five symbols etched into mirror, with personalized corner colors and a central family symbol.
description: This small stained-glass window contains five symbols etched into mirror pieces. Four symbols sit in the corners, with each one representing a person and surrounded by the color associated with that person.
The fifth symbol is positioned in the center and represents the family as a whole. The remaining space along the sides is yellow, chosen because it is Mom's favorite color.

details.Color Meaning: Individual colors represent each person; yellow is Mom's favorite
